task: Grant Velero fs-backup the two permissions it needs (nodes get, events in storage) without widening anything else (Narwhal#418)

events.summary: Permission widening is a design change (AGENTS.md). Scope: ClusterRole nodes get, plus a namespaced Role/RoleBinding for events get/list/watch in storage. READ inventory and schedule includedResources must not change; scripts/cluster/08-4-storage.sh, the Velero chart values and the API snapshot are out of scope.

Live on kakao-narwhal (2026-10-18): a PodVolumeBackup failed with 'cannot get resource nodes at the cluster scope'; after granting only nodes get it stayed Prepared because node-agent (same ServiceAccount) could not list events in storage; with exactly those two grants the PVB completed 33/33 bytes and a restore returned the data. The temporary grants were deleted afterwards.
evidence: runtime:kubectl --context kakao-narwhal get podvolumebackups.velero.io (Failed, then Completed)
artifact:Narwhal#416 comment with the live run

events.summary: gen-velero-rbac.py keeps nodes and events in the denylist (list/watch and cluster-wide events stay denied) and adds one nodes get rule plus a Role/RoleBinding velero-node-agent-events in storage; velero-server-rbac.yaml regenerated; check-velero-rbac.py caps both grants and rejects 13 mutations.

events.scope: generated RBAC bytes, schedule inventory, grant ceilings and 13 negative mutations (static) plus server-side dry-run against the live API server
events.summary: gen-velero-rbac.py --check --check-schedules reports no drift and an unchanged 160-resource READ inventory; check-velero-rbac.py R204-R209 and R215 invocations pass; disabling the Role apiGroups check or the RoleBinding namespace check makes the corresponding mutation escape (so the tests bite); kubectl apply --dry-run=server on kakao-narwhal accepted the manifest.
make test passed 399 failed 0 (reviewer and author runs); an independent reviewer rejected 16 hostile edits of the generated YAML.

The generated RBAC grants exactly nodes get and a storage-only events Role and the checks cap them. Not claimed: the permanent RBAC is applied to the cluster (ArgoCD reads Gitea), or that the next scheduled backup produces PodVolumeBackups.
Static change verified with a live server-side dry-run and a prior live reproduction with the same two grants; live application of the permanent RBAC is a follow-up after merge.
